decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch that builds directly on the firm’s core spraying business and remained on the website through 2024, management is likely to justify the investment and view any weak uptake as temporary rather than exit quickly.

The low-pressure injection pump is close to the established offer, has its own product page, and has been publicly backed with a field-reference story, which raises commitment and makes withdrawal unlikely.

Because this is a product line with several models built on proven in-house air-motor technology, the firm has made a broader resource commitment and would be strongly inclined to continue rather than reverse course.

Although fire protection flow monitoring is somewhat more adjacent than the classic equipment lines, its own page and fit with the firm’s stated move toward future-oriented and interoperable solutions support continued backing.

This 2024 hydraulic two-component spraying system has the shortest market history and a lighter public commitment so far, but because it is still close to the core business management would likely give it more time before dropping it.
